summary: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing a monthly report and a press release announcing a cash distribution of $0.086440 per trust certificate, payable May 11, 2026 to holders of record May 8, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is described. The filing is a routine disclosure of monthly performance and a regular distribution, lacking any special-situation event.
